messages:
anna_devex: FYI team — scheduling check for next week's on‑call shadows and handoffs. We have a couple of coverage gaps Tue/Wed night where primary+secondary overlap is weak. Need volunteers to shadow and a couple of people to be listed as backup for escalation. Please reply with which slots you can cover.

sam_oncall: I can take Tue 00:00-08:00 UTC as primary and shadow whoever's on for the previous shift. Can be backup for Wed night if needed.

mike_sre: Happy to shadow Tue night and do a handoff with Sam. Quick q: where's the canonical runbook for paging escalation and the GPU node checks? I have a new hire joining this week, want to point them at the right docs.

anna_devex: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-paging-and-escalation — includes PagerDuty play, SLAs, and customer-impact templates. Also link to runtime ops GPU checklist: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-gpu-triage.

irene_support: tagging the customer-impact template — when you get paged for a user-facing latency regression, please fill the short triage form: https://forms.redwood.internal/incident/customer-impact — it auto-notifies CS. Saves a lot of back-and-forth.

mike_sre: Nice. Can we add the quick triage snippet to the onboarding checklist? For new joiners the first 3 pages should be a walkthrough: acknowledgement, runbook quick checks, and handoff template.

anna_devex: Agreed — i'll update the onboarding checklist. For immediate use, copy/paste this during shadowing when a page comes in: 
``` 
1) ACK in PD: `/pd ack <incident_id>`
2) Run quick checks: `redwoodctl nodes status --filter=serving`, `redwoodctl logs --tail 200 --service=inference-runtime`
3) Check metrics: grafana link -> Prod/Latency -> top routes
4) Post initial postmortem stub and customer-impact form (link above)
```

mike_sre: Perfect. Also add the quick rollback command snippet for model variant fallback: 
```
# roll back to latest-stable model for safety
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model-group=llama-family --to=latest-stable
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT SIMULATION: paging test 1798000000-TEST triggered by ops-playbook. Please acknowledge to practice.

sam_oncall: acked the test. got the PD modal and the test alert details. 👍 looks good.

nate_newhire: i'm scheduled to shadow on Wed 08:00-16:00 UTC — would love a short pre-shadowing run through (10-15m) on how pages look and where to find logs. Who can do that?

mike_sre: I can do a 15m pre-shadow call at 07:45 UTC Wed. I'll walk through PD alert flow, where to check runtime health, and how to fill the customer-impact form.

anna_devex: Thanks Mike. Nate — i'll add you to the shadow rota and create a quick checklist in the onboarding doc. Also: handoff expectations (short checklist to paste into the channel during handoff):
- current incidents (id + short status)
- high-risk customers and any ongoing mitigations
- planned deploys in your window
- any infra maintenance windows
- commands you ran/next steps

irene_support: adding that the handoff should always include whether CS needs to be paged for active customer impact. If yes, include customer names + ticket IDs.

sam_oncall: one more thing — we have that 02:00 maintenance window Tue; i'll be on for it. want someone as secondary for the maintenance just in case. anyone free 01:30-03:30 UTC Tue?

mike_sre: i'll be available 01:30-03:30 UTC Tue, can be secondary for maintenance.

anna_devex: Great. Updated rota: Sam primary Tue overnight, Mike secondary for maintenance window; Nate shadow Wed day with 07:45 pre-shadow sync. I still need one backup for Wed night 20:00-04:00 UTC — any volunteers?

nate_newhire: if no one else, i can shadow Wed night too (happy to help), but i'm still learning — prefer to be secondary rather than primary.

sam_oncall: noted — Nate as secondary Wed night and shadower. Thanks.

mike_sre: i'll add a small troubleshooting cheatsheet to the runbook under "new-joiner quick wins" — will include common PD alerts and the signal->action mapping.

anna_devex: awesome — final actions: 
1) Mike: add cheatsheet & pre-shadow agenda (due EOD today).
2) Anna (me): update onboarding doc + rota page.
3) Sam: confirm maintenance runbook link and prepare deploy notes.
4) Nate: show up 07:45 Wed for the pre-shadow call; i'll DM calendar invite.

incident-bot: REMINDER: next simulated page scheduled 1798000600 for validating secondary escalation paths. Please don't use real incident channels for the simulation.

sam_oncall: got it. I ran through the PD ack flow earlier and confirmed escalation to oncall-secondary works.

nate_newhire: thanks everyone — excited to shadow. appreciate the links.

anna_devex: Thank you all. If anyone's plan changes, post here ASAP so I can update the rota and notify CS for handoffs. :pray:
